Issued when engagement monitoring detects a student below a defined threshold.

### Consequence
Arrival prompts tutor contact and early intervention. Absence allows disengagement to continue undetected.

Name: Financial Hardship Flag
Documentation:
### Object
The indicator that a student is experiencing financial hardship, based on advice session outcomes.

### Condition
Issued when financial advice identifies hardship and the student consents to sharing with wellbeing services.

### Consequence
Arrival connects financial and wellbeing support. Absence leaves financial stress unaddressed and affects mental health.

Name: Health Support Plan
Documentation:
### Object
The summary of a student's health support plan, including recommended adjustments and key contacts.

### Condition
Issued when health and wellbeing services complete an assessment and produce a support plan for academic staff.

### Consequence
Arrival informs personal tutors of the support needed. Absence leaves tutors unaware and may inadvertently undermine student health.

Name: Wellbeing Impact Report
Documentation:
### Object
The report indicating how wellbeing issues affect a student's engagement and learning.

### Condition
Issued when health and wellbeing services assess the impact and share it with retention staff.

### Consequence
Arrival adjusts retention interventions to account for wellbeing. Absence separates health from engagement and lessens support effectiveness.

Name: Digital Learning Materials
Documentation:
### Object
The packaged set of online learning materials, including text, video, quizzes, and interactive content.

### Condition
Issued when content has been approved and published within the learning platform.

### Consequence
Arrival makes non-presence teaching possible and gives students access to structured learning. Absence leaves the online course empty.

Name: Classroom Teaching Resources
Documentation:
### Object
The physical and digital resources required for classroom teaching, including slides, handouts, and equipment lists.

### Condition
Issued when resources are prepared and aligned to the teaching timetable.

### Consequence
Arrival enables face-to-face sessions to run as planned. Absence forces improvisation and reduces teaching quality.

Name: Learning Progress Report
Documentation:
### Object
The report on a student's progress through non-presence learning, including activity completion and assessment scores.

### Condition
Issued when online learning activity is recorded and prepared for placement consideration.

### Consequence
Arrival informs placement readiness and identifies students needing pre-placement support. Absence leaves placement decisions blind to online performance.

Name: Student Performance Report
Documentation:
### Object
The report of a student's performance in in-person settings, including participation, formative marks, and tutor observations.

### Condition
Issued when classroom performance data is collated for placement assessment.

### Consequence
Arrival supports placement matching and suitability review. Absence leaves placement providers without evidence of practical ability.

Name: Placement Feedback
Documentation:
### Object
The feedback from a placement, including student reflections, employer comments, and suggested curriculum improvements.

### Condition
Issued when a placement concludes and feedback is collected from all parties.

### Consequence
Arrival updates curriculum content to align with practice. Absence lets curriculum drift from employer expectations.

Name: Online Delivery Report
Documentation:
### Object
The report summarising online delivery metrics, including engagement, completion, and resource usage.

### Condition
Issued when online course analytics are compiled for a defined period.

### Consequence
Arrival informs content improvement and resource reallocation. Absence leaves online delivery unmonitored for effectiveness.

Name: Classroom Feedback
Documentation:
### Object
The feedback from classroom teaching, including student questions, resource needs, and delivery issues.

### Condition
Issued when teaching staff report on what worked and what needs were unmet.

### Consequence
Arrival prompts content revisions and resource updates. Absence continues the same delivery problems in future sessions.

Name: Capability Blueprint
Documentation:
### Object
This is a capability blueprint that maps enabling capabilities to intended benefits and outcomes.

### Condition
It is issued when architecture validates the capability-benefit relationships. Arrival means the blueprint is available to plan benefit realisation.

### Consequence
On arrival, benefit maps are built from the blueprint and each benefit has an owner and measure. While absent, benefit mapping lacks the capability linkages and benefits are not traceable to enabling changes.

Name: Benefit Realisation Plans
Documentation:
### Object
This is a set of benefit realisation plans specifying expected benefits, measures, and tracking responsibilities for projects.

### Condition
It is issued after benefits are identified and approved for a project. Arrival means the benefits plan is available for inclusion in delivery.

### Consequence
On arrival, project delivery incorporates benefit measures and tracks progress against planned benefits. While absent, projects deliver outputs without defined benefit measures and realisation is not tracked.

Name: Prioritised Change Portfolio
Documentation:
### Object
This is a prioritised change portfolio listing approved change initiatives with priority scores and architectural impact.

### Condition
It is issued after portfolio prioritisation decisions are made. Arrival means the demand context for architecture planning is available.

### Consequence
On arrival, architecture plans and standards are aligned with the prioritised initiatives. While absent, architecture planning has no visibility of change demand and standards are developed without portfolio context.

Name: Project Status Report
Documentation:
### Object
This is a project status report carrying progress, risks, issues, and variance against plan.

### Condition
It is issued at each reporting cycle or exception event. Arrival means current delivery status is available for portfolio oversight.

### Consequence
On arrival, portfolio dashboards are updated and interventions are triggered for off-track projects. While absent, the change portfolio has no current project status and delivery slippage goes undetected.

Name: Role Definitions
Documentation:
### Object
This is the set of role definitions with responsibilities for quality activities, including ownership of processes and quality controls.

### Condition
It is issued after organisational design approves quality-related role assignments. Arrival means the authority model for quality ownership is available.

### Consequence
On arrival, quality responsibilities are assigned to the defined roles and process owners are held accountable. While absent, quality ownership is ambiguous and process control gaps are not assigned.

Name: Quality Standards
Documentation:
### Object
This is a set of quality standards and procedures governing project deliverables, reviews, and acceptance criteria.

### Condition
It is issued after quality management approves the standards. Arrival means the mandatory quality requirements are available for project delivery.

### Consequence
On arrival, project teams apply the standards to all deliverables and quality gates are enforced. While absent, project deliverables are produced without agreed quality standards and acceptance is ad hoc.

Name: Architecture Compliance Criteria
Documentation:
### Object
This is a set of criteria for assessing whether projects comply with architecture standards and patterns.

### Condition
It is issued when architecture standards are updated. Arrival means the compliance checklist is available for project reviews.

### Consequence
On arrival, quality reviews evaluate projects against the architecture criteria and non-compliant designs are flagged. While absent, quality reviews lack architecture compliance checks and non-standard designs pass unchallenged.

Name: Benefit-Driven Capability Requirements
Documentation:
### Object
This is a set of capability requirements derived from expected benefits, specifying what organisational capabilities must be created or changed.

### Condition
It is issued when benefit plans are approved. Arrival means the capability demand for structural design is available.

### Consequence
On arrival, structures and accountabilities are designed to meet the benefit-driven capability requirements. While absent, organisational design lacks benefit-driven capability demand and structures are designed without benefit linkage.
